_meta.verification_note: Values were entered from the authors' knowledge of the cited documents WITHOUT live access to the sources (the build environment had no internet). Every criterion is therefore marked 'unverified_offline'. Confirm each value against the source URL before relying on it, then set verification_status to 'verified' and note the date. Nothing here is endorsed by BIS, WHO, CPCB, IBM or the UN.

criterion_types.health_based: Derived from health evidence; exceedance warrants public-health follow-up.
criterion_types.aesthetic_or_operational: Acceptability (taste, appearance) or treatment/operational indicator; not on its own a health determination.
criterion_types.environmental_indicator: Surface-water designated-use indicator; not a drinking-water guideline.

BIS_IS10500_acceptable.label: BIS IS 10500 - Acceptable Limit (India, drinking water)
BIS_IS10500_acceptable.applicability: Drinking water in India (not packaged water). Screens only pH, turbidity and TDS against the 'Acceptable Limit' column; this is NOT a compliance check against the full standard.
BIS_IS10500_acceptable.edition: IS 10500:2012 (edition number and any later amendment/revision to be confirmed)

ph.note: Acceptable limit range; no relaxation in absence of alternate source.

turbidity_ntu.note: Acceptable limit 1 NTU; permissible limit in absence of alternate source is 5 NTU.

tds_mg_l.note: Acceptable limit 500 mg/L; permissible limit in absence of alternate source is 2000 mg/L.

BIS_IS10500_permissible.label: BIS IS 10500 - Permissible Limit in absence of alternate source
BIS_IS10500_permissible.applicability: Used where no alternate source exists; relaxed upper limits. Screening only; not a compliance check.
BIS_IS10500_permissible.edition: IS 10500:2012 (edition number and any later amendment/revision to be confirmed)

turbidity_ntu.note: Permissible limit in absence of alternate source.

tds_mg_l.note: Permissible limit in absence of alternate source.

WHO_GDWQ_operational.label: WHO GDWQ - Operational/acceptability indicators (conservative)
WHO_GDWQ_operational.applicability: International drinking-water guidance. WHO sets NO health-based guideline value for pH, TDS or turbidity; the values below are operational/acceptability indicators only. Temperature and conductivity are intentionally left unconfigured.
WHO_GDWQ_operational.standard: Guidelines for drinking-water quality, 4th edition incorporating the 1st and 2nd addenda

ph.note: Commonly cited operational range; optimum pH varies with water and distribution materials.

turbidity_ntu.note: Ideal below 1 NTU for effective disinfection; not a health-based guideline value.

tds_mg_l.note: Taste acceptability: generally good below 600 mg/L; no health-based guideline value.

CPCB_surface_water_class_A.label: CPCB Designated Best Use Class A - drinking-water source (surface water, indicative)
CPCB_surface_water_class_A.applicability: Raw surface-water sources (lakes, rivers) before conventional treatment, India. An environmental-indicator profile, NOT a drinking-water guideline for treated or tap water.
CPCB_surface_water_class_A.standard: CPCB Water Quality Criteria - Designated Best Use Classification

tds_mg_l.note: Class A total dissolved solids 500 mg/L.
